_doc: GATE B RESULT: metered T0 characterization of the committed iso-current hop (dV=1.0, L=277.8nH, switch open at 50+342=392ps as committed). Cells' ports metered (ground returns + inputs; supply derived by block neutrality, validated against direct supply meters to 0.001 fC on the slow ramp). Verdict against gateb/PRE_REGISTERED.json.

instrument_checks_MEASURED.slow_ramp_vs_committed_curve: Q within +0.04%, E within +/-0.11% at every committed checkpoint; QTOT 35.983 vs 35.979 fC (+0.01%)
instrument_checks_MEASURED.closure_T3: Q_L integrator 34.268 fC vs exact CA bookkeeping 34.270 fC (0.006%); E_outA integrator 17.948 vs exact 17.949 fJ

hop_ledger_fC_fJ_MEASURED.phases: A=turn-on edge(48-55ps), B=traverse(55-392ps), C=turn-off edge(392-399ps), D=hold(399-887ps); cumulative at A/B/C/D

pinned_variant_MEASURED.note: all cell channels pinned OFF, same drive/timing: displacement-only floor
pinned_variant_MEASURED.reading: ~3/4 of the cells' quasi-static intake is off-state displacement; the rest is channel-mediated CL/channel charge -- STORED, not burned. Even with zero cell conduction the bank peaks at 0.63, not the behavioural model's 0.97: the switch dominates either way.

verdict: REFUTED against the pre-registered bands: cells' dynamic excess charge = 0.05 fC (band [9.75,16.25]); cells' dissipated energy = 1.04 fJ (band [6.21,10.35]); closure T3 PASS. The ~13 fC gap is the TRANSFER SWITCH's own dynamic charge, not the cells': the 60um transmission gate injects 8.27 fC into the bank at turn-ON (drive feedthrough/channel formation -- visible in the COMMITTED trace as V(bkb)=0.117V at t=50ps before any inductor current), absorbs 24.39 fC of the through-flow during the rail traverse (pMOS channel charge grows as its Vsg rises with the bank; overlap/junction displacement into gt/gtp/vhi), and returns ~2.5 fC at turn-off/ring: net 13.59 fC of the 34.27 fC through-L never reaches the cells. The cells receive 20.68 fC = the static Q(V_end)=20.63 fC + 0.05; crowbar bounded at 0.035 fC. Gate burn is 1.04 fJ, not 8.28: the hop loss is switch-dominated (9.6 of 10.8 fJ).
what_the_charge_bound_missed: It compared charge through the INDUCTOR against the static bank curve, assuming everything through L reaches the bank node; the transmission gate between them carries channel+overlap+junction charge of the same order as the whole bank's charge. Also the 22 fC bound was taken at V_B_peak; the end-state comparison point is Q(0.5763)=20.63 fC.
model_consequence: v3's suggested next step (heavier CY / stronger cell conduction) is also contradicted: the fix belongs in qal_hop.va (the switch), which today carries NO charge (CJ=0, pure conductance). It needs the transmission gate's drive-feedthrough + channel/overlap charge (tens of fF scale, ~55 fF effective during the traverse). This reproduces silicon's VBpk: model bank absorbs ~34 fC -> 0.97 V; silicon bank absorbs 20.7 fC -> 0.58-0.61 V.
committed_row_quirk_found: qal_hop_gates.py probe_zero() returns the ABSOLUTE crossing time (342.0 includes T0=50ps) but hop_deck() reuses it as a duration after T0: every committed hop opens the switch 50ps past the true zero, with I(LT) = -100uA flowing (IZ in the committed mt0). Internally consistent across all committed rows, but 't_zcs' is not zero-current switching.
